description: A fictional stylised low-poly video-game prop, a chunky toy-like cartoon 3D game asset (not a real object, no working parts). Two long round dark grey tubes, one directly above the other: the upper tube thick with an open front end and a small orange bead on top near that end, the lower tube almost as long and ending in an orange cap; the two joined near the front end by a flat dark grey clamp plate. Round the lower tube, about a third of the way back, a chunky matte black sleeve with four deep vertical grooves on its side. Behind the tubes a slab-sided dark grey main body block with a flat top. Behind the block a matte black handle raked backward, a small curved lever inside a rounded dark grey loop under the block, and a matte black shoulder piece with a straight top line widening to a tall flat end pad. Bright orange accents: the cap on the front end of the lower tube, the small bead on top of the upper tube, and a small round button on the left flank of the main body at its rear end. The right flank is plain.
proportions: About 1.00 m long, 0.06 m wide and 0.20 m tall. (length : width : height = 16.67 : 1 : 3.33)
sides: the small orange round button is on the left flank; the right flank is plain; everything else is symmetric left to right.
